_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local nodes for band5_stronghold_approach. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because the merged array order is the order harvest nodes are added to the scene tree. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 5000-5999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.
